output.summary: Agency spend growth is about 77% volume and 23% rate, so it is mainly a volume problem, not a price problem. Vacancies and resignations began rising in 2024, well before St. Brennan's opened, and only 19 of 98 known leavers went there. Leavers cite workload and charge or precepting burden (49%) far more than pay (17%). The 4 West pilot cut the charge and orientation load, and its exhaustion scores and resignations fell against matched units with similar agency share. That supports a self-reinforcing loop. The 2025 bonus did not sustain lower vacancy. The proposed $15k bonus, funded by cutting charge and preceptor differentials, would worsen the load. Extend the 4 West model. Renegotiating the agency rate is a secondary lever. Falls and time-to-hire remain unestablished.
